criteria.text: Published Base source transaction, Circle message hash/attestation, Stellar destination transaction, and explorer links demonstrate a reconciled Base-to-Stellar testnet transfer through CctpForwarder.
Equivalent public evidence demonstrates the reverse Stellar-to-Base flow and its eligible Avenia BRL settlement state.

A redacted append-only export and public schema reconcile quote, authorization, Avenia ticket, source transaction, CCTP identifiers, destination transaction, and terminal balance under one durable transfer ID.
Public CI covers six-to-seven-decimal USDC normalization, duplicates/replay, expired quotes, timeout, retry, refund, and incomplete transfers.
